sources.authority: Kenya Ministry of Interior / Kenya Gazette
sources.title: Gazette Vol. 17, 14 February 2024 — Special Issue: Administrative Units
sources.location: PDF page numbered 526; KIAMBU COUNTY > GITHUNGURI SUB-COUNTY
sources.finding: Kiambururu appears under Locations within Githunguri Sub-County, Kiambu County.
sources.limitation: No GeoNames ID or stable machine-readable identifier crosswalk is supplied.

sources.title: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission Act No. 9 of 2011
sources.finding: Historical schedule lists Kiambururu among the sub-locations of Kiambu County.
sources.limitation: Historical schedule does not include GeoNames ID 192705 or prove a formal reclassification date.

sources.title: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census: Volume II — Distribution of Population by Administrative Units
sources.finding: Indexed official census table contains the exact KIAMBURURU row and a population value of 4,000.
sources.limitation: The row corroborates the name but does not publish a GeoNames ID crosswalk.

sources.title: County Annual Development Plan FY 2026/2027, November 2025
sources.location: Printed page 18 / PDF page index 17, sections 1.1.3 Administrative units and 1.1.4 Political Units
findings: The administrative-units section says Meru County's structure comprises sixteen sub-counties.
Table 1 lists Imenti Central as a sub-county with 4 divisions, 22 locations, 57 sub-locations and area 333.10 km².
The next section separately lists Imenti Central as a parliamentary constituency, so the two same-named unit types must not be conflated.
sources.limitation: No direct identifier crosswalk to GeoNames ID 7800132 is published.

sources.title: Githunguri Location, ID 197219
sources.finding: A distinct administrative-division entry called Githunguri Location (ADMD).
sources.limitation: The Gazette names Githunguri Sub-County as Kiambururu Location's parent; ID 197219 is not treated as that sub-county.

sources.title: Kiambururu Sub-Location, ID 192705
sources.finding: Record is labelled Kiambururu Sub-Location (ADM3); its displayed hierarchy has no parent link.

sources.title: Imenti Central, ID 7800132
sources.finding: Record is labelled Imenti Central (ADM3); its displayed hierarchy has no parent link.
